$comment: Hosts the deployed web app may contact, by network purpose (NetPurpose in web/src/security/net.ts, the only module that calls fetch). Each value is an array of entries: "self" for the app's own origin, or a bare origin such as "https://example.org". An empty array means the app contacts no fixed host for that purpose. Hosts the user enters (a provider endpoint, an MCP server, a sync relay) are not fixed and are not listed; net.ts still requires HTTPS or the loopback for them and shows each one in the transparency panel. Adding a host here is a reviewed change.

$purposes.app: The app's own files: the shell, its chunks, the manifest, the service worker and its precache.
$purposes.provider: The default API hosts of the model providers the app ships (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter). The OpenAI-compatible presets of the bundled catalog (web/src/core/ai/catalog.json), which a request reaches only once the user picked one, the providers of the full llm-models list (web/src/core/ai/catalog-all.json), reached only at a base URL the user confirms, and user-entered endpoints (local servers, OpenAI-compatible services, custom base URLs) are not listed.
$purposes.mcp: MCP servers and their OAuth authorization servers. Every one is added by the user (an endpoint, or an authorization server it names), so none are listed; net.ts requires HTTPS or the loopback.
$purposes.tool: Hosts a tool reaches once the user approved the call (the built-in fetch_url, the pages Deep research reads with research_read): chosen by the conversation, never fixed, so none are listed.
$purposes.sync: The fixed API hosts of the sync destinations the app ships (GitHub). Carries the aparte/1 objects only: ciphertext, the format marker and the keyslots. User-entered stores (an S3 endpoint, a self-hosted relay) are not listed.
$purposes.download: Pinned, hash-checked downloads of in-browser model files and runtimes. The model workers read Hugging Face model repositories at a fixed commit (huggingface.co, which redirects the large files to its CDN hosts below, by region) and the compiled WebLLM model libraries at a fixed commit of mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs (raw.githubusercontent.com); ONNX Runtime is self-hosted under the app's origin. The sandbox host fetches Pyodide, its packages and Mermaid from jsDelivr (web/src/core/sandbox/runtime-lock.json) and hands them to the sandbox frames, which have no network. Every file is checked against a SHA-256 shipped with the app.
$purposes.skills: Importing a skill from a public GitHub repository: the GitHub REST API (the repository, the commit a ref points to, its file tree) and raw.githubusercontent.com (the files, at that commit). Unauthenticated; no token is ever sent.
$purposes.research: The keyless search backends of Deep research (web/src/core/research/backends.ts), each checked to answer a cross-origin GET from a browser with an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, and the CORS-friendly APIs research_read falls back to for a page (Wikipedia articles, RFCs). The backends of the ultrasearch skill that a browser cannot reach are listed under $research-unreachable.
$purposes.catalog: Placeholder: the model catalog the app refreshes, if it is fetched rather than bundled.

$research-unreachable.duckduckgo: html.duckduckgo.com/html and lite.duckduckgo.com/lite: HTTP 403 to a scripted request and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (probed 2026-10-18).
$research-unreachable.dblp: dblp.org/search/publ/api: an HTTP 202 bot challenge without Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
$research-unreachable.arxiv: export.arxiv.org/api/query: no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (and HTTP 429 under load); arxiv.org pages neither.
$research-unreachable.semanticscholar: api.semanticscholar.org: answers its preflight, but its unauthenticated GETs came back HTTP 429 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so a browser cannot rely on it.
$research-unreachable.wayback: web.archive.org snapshots: redirects without Access-Control-Allow-Origin (archive.org's availability API has it, the snapshot it names does not).
$research-unreachable.searxng, firecrawl: self-hosted servers on the user's machine, not fixed hosts; not offered.
$research-unreachable.pepper: deal sites, not a research source; not offered.
